requests.text: Music is a universal language that connects people on a deep, emotional level. It is a universal language that allows us to express our thoughts, emotions, and feelings, and to bond with others on a profound level. We may be from different cultures or speak different languages, but our love for music transcends these barriers. Music has a unique power to evoke a universal response from people, it speaks to us on a primal level, and it has the ability to heal, comfort, and inspire us.
